finding: Review workload by tag before changing resource allocation.
time_series_evidence: 6/13 study tags meet the fixed steep-decline forecast threshold; ALL changes -37.6% at 26 weeks.
text_mining_evidence: Global frustration-phrase share changes -0.21 pp (95% CI -0.46 to +0.04).
action: Compare question counts, queue age and observed moderation workload monthly; pilot allocation changes only after measuring demand.
kpi_to_track: Queue age and moderation hours per 1,000 questions
caveat: No staffing or effort data were collected; declining traffic does not itself imply less moderation demand.

finding: Test documentation topics suggested by changing vocabulary.
time_series_evidence: ALL validation-selected 26-week forecast is 134.2 questions/week versus 215 last observed.
text_mining_evidence: Top global rising keywords: numbertoken (z=162.9); numbertoken numbertoken (z=144.0); nextjs (z=126.7).
action: Inspect linked questions for these keywords and trial a documentation guide with an explicit success measure.
kpi_to_track: Guide use and repeat-question share before/after a controlled pilot
caveat: Keyword shifts are proxies, may reflect technical-token artifacts and do not establish documentation need.

finding: Pilot expert routing for a growing topic and measure resolution.
time_series_evidence: Python ITS growth-rate shift is -2.34%/week after the fixed launch boundary.
text_mining_evidence: Docker containers and images: global share +1.28 pp; dominant-topic 7-day resolution 32.0% (n=8,598).
action: Use a small expert-routing pilot and compare outcomes against a contemporaneous control queue.
kpi_to_track: 7-day resolution and median first-answer hours in pilot versus control
caveat: Automatic topic labels are provisional. A gain in global share does not demonstrate difficulty or migration from AI tools.

finding: Evaluate a clearer question template as an experiment.
time_series_evidence: ALL projected 26-week volume change is -37.6%; no intervention effect is estimated.
text_mining_evidence: Global weighted median prose changes +13 words and code +4 lines.
action: Trial prompts for expected behaviour, minimal code and version details, with a control group.
kpi_to_track: Completion rate, question edits and 7-day resolution under random assignment
caveat: Longer text is not proof of greater difficulty. VADER and frustration flags are weak exploratory signals and should not gate users.

finding: Audit forecast calibration before setting automatic alerts.
time_series_evidence: SARIMAX 26-week matched-origin 95% coverage is 52.0%; skill versus naive is 55.9%.
text_mining_evidence: Arrays and object manipulation shows a global topic-share change of -1.80 pp.
action: Track live forecast errors and recalibrate intervals before using them as operational alert thresholds.
kpi_to_track: Rolling 80/95% interval coverage and false-alert rate
caveat: Current intervals under-cover; their nominal label must not be interpreted as verified reliability.

finding: Monitor emerging tags without percentage classes from a zero baseline.
time_series_evidence: openai-api ITS level shift +1644.9%; growth-rate shift -2.56%/week; class: not classifiable: zero baseline.
text_mining_evidence: openai-api within-tag topics: API requests and responses (+9.66 pp); SQL queries and tables (+1.35 pp); Android development and builds (+1.05 pp).
action: Review absolute counts and linked topic examples monthly before proposing specialist routing.
kpi_to_track: Absolute weekly questions and tag-specific resolution rate
caveat: Sparse tags and automatic labels make interpretation uncertain; a level step is not a sustained growth trend.
